column1: # The text maxon prints for a diagnostic, one row per situation: the source of truth for self/diag/messages_gen.maxon.
# Run `go generate ./internal/...` after an edit. Columns, separated by tabs:
#   function   the name of the generated function
#   constant   the row of codes.tsv that the situation is reported under
#   template   maxon's message, whose {placeholders} become the string parameters of the function, in the order of their
#              first use; a template holds no quote or backslash
# A code may have several rows, one for each situation maxon words alone. A situation that only minimaxon refuses, or
# that minimaxon words for a rule it changed, has no row and keeps its text at the place that raises it.
